Kanto path and fence kits

Nine small path atlases and two fence kits compiled from the included Pokémon source profile. Shared paths are indexed by their city/route uses rather than duplicated. No ROM file or complete native tileset atlas is included.

Pokémon game graphics: Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc.
Loaded source graphics: retain the original game authors’ applicable credits and terms.
These transformations do not change the original artwork’s permissions.

The centred white rail is an explicitly new composition of copied native rail/post pixels. The iron gate open state composes the original outer posts around a clear passage. Neither is a claimed extracted animation frame.
